= cache

Concurrent loading, expiring, refreshing caches with configurable LRU size and
weight eviction. Cache is inherently thread-safe and has no `_ts` twin.

- New/NewFunc and NewLoading/NewLoadingFunc cover comparable and custom keys.
- GetIfPresent/Peek, Put, atomic PutIfAbsent/Replace/DeleteValue, individual,
  bulk, and full invalidation, CleanUp, snapshots, iteration, and stats.
- Get/GetWith coalesce same-key misses, allow unrelated loads concurrently, and
  never run loaders under the policy lock. Recursive same-key loads through the
  loader context return ErrRecursiveLoad. Waiter cancellation is independent;
  the initiating caller controls the shared load.
- Expire after write/access and refresh after write use an injectable clock.
  Refresh returns the old value while replacement runs; failure retains it.
  Direct writes/invalidate prevent late load completion from overwriting them.
- Maximum size/weight use static write-time weights and per-shard LRU
  eviction. Maximum zero discards completed writes.
- Optional bulk loading preserves input order and retains partial successes.
- Removal listeners report explicit, replaced, expired, size, and loader-error
  causes outside locks, synchronously by default or with a listener executor.
- Stats include hits, misses, loads, successes/failures, load time, and evictions.
  Expiration and size eviction both count as evictions, matching Guava.

== Complexity

[cols="2,3"]
|===
| Operation | Cost
| GetIfPresent / Peek / Get hit | O(1) average, one shard lock, no allocation
| Put / PutIfAbsent / Replace / Invalidate / DeleteValue | O(1) average plus O(expired + evicted) in the key's shard
| Len / Stats / ClearStats | O(shards + expired), all shards locked
| Snapshot / All / InvalidateAll | O(n + shards), all shards locked
| InvalidateKeys | O(k + shards + expired), all shards locked
| CleanUp | O(shards + expired + evicted), one shard at a time
|===

Expiration drains expired entries from time-ordered queues, so its cost is
proportional to the number expired, never the cache size.

== Concurrency

The cache is split into independently locked shards. `WithConcurrencyLevel(n)`
defaults to 16 and is rounded up to a power of two. Bounded caches get fewer
shards (Guava's rule: doubling stops once shards×20 exceeds the bound, so a
cache bounded below 20 has one shard and exact LRU). Size/weight limits, LRU
order, and expiration cleanup are per shard. The global limits always hold.
`Len`, `Snapshot`, `Stats`, `InvalidateKeys`, and `InvalidateAll` are atomic
across shards.

== Panics

Nil key functions, loader, weigher, clock, executor, or value equality;
negative size, weight, duration, or entry weight; total weight overflow; and a
concurrency level below 1.

Operation-driven cleanup is the baseline; no goroutine runs per cache by default.
Refresh uses short-lived executor tasks. Weak/soft references and existing cache
serialization formats are unchanged and out of scope.
